body:
ON DELETE / ORM cascade and how you load related rows.

Why it matters: Deleting a parent without a plan orphans children or fails the DELETE. Loading without include/selectinload causes N+1 queries in real apps.

SQL ↔ ORM: SQL ON DELETE CASCADE ↔ Prisma onDelete: Cascade ↔ SQLAlchemy ForeignKey(..., ondelete='CASCADE') / relationship cascade options.
why: Deleting a parent without a plan orphans children or fails the DELETE. Loading without include/selectinload causes N+1 queries in real apps.
objectives: Choose ON DELETE CASCADE vs SET NULL vs RESTRICT intentionally.
Contrast DB-level ON DELETE with ORM cascade flags.
Prefer explicit loading strategies for related collections.
pitfalls: CASCADE everywhere — easy demos, dangerous production defaults.
N+1 queries from lazy loads in a loop.
mappingNotes: SQL ON DELETE CASCADE ↔ Prisma onDelete: Cascade ↔ SQLAlchemy ForeignKey(..., ondelete='CASCADE') / relationship cascade options.
teachAlong: Effect: DB applies ON DELETE policy to child FKs.
Loading: ask for related rows in one query when you need them.
